sections.heading: Scope
lines: Ambattur Denim Unit. Scenario S1, Basin first.
OPP-A Wetland phase 2, Pallikaranai buffer: +8,000 m³/yr (±30%)
OPP-B Constructed wetland polishing, Adyar tributary: TSS 1,800, TN 260, TP 45 kg/yr (±30%)
OPP-C Community WASH extension, Adyar riverside: +600 people (±15%)

sections.heading: Alternatives compared
lines: No-project baseline: PWI 69.8%, volumetric balance 73.6%.
S2 Efficiency and reuse: PWI 70.4%, volumetric balance 80.5%, payback 11.0 years.
S3 Balanced: PWI 77.8%, volumetric balance 90.9%, payback No financial payback.

sections.heading: Funding needs
lines: Capex ₹205 lakh over 14 months.

sections.heading: Operating and monitoring costs
lines: ₹11 lakh a year. Net savings -₹11 lakh a year after operating costs.

sections.heading: Assumptions
lines: Water saved is valued at ₹150/m³.
Targets stay frozen at baseline.
Forecast benefit is never added to Measured or Validated totals.
Criterion weights are demonstration weights; rubric adaptation is pending.

sections.heading: Risks
lines: OPP-A: uncertainty ±30%. Annual satellite inundation and depth survey.
OPP-B: uncertainty ±30%. Matched inlet and outlet flows with weekly lab results.
OPP-C: uncertainty ±15%. Quarterly functionality check and beneficiary list.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
lines: Brand approves the delivery baseline. The supplier delivers and uploads monitoring evidence.

sections.heading: Timing
lines: OPP-A: 14 months
OPP-B: 9 months
OPP-C: 8 months

sections.heading: Uncertainty
lines: Site PWI 81.6% central, 78.6% low.
Volumetric balance 80.9% central, 78.7% low.

sections.heading: Stewardship value (no financial payback)
lines: Savings do not exceed operating costs, so this case rests on stewardship value.
Site PWI 69.8% to 81.6% (+11.8 points)
Volumetric balance 73.6% to 80.9% (+7.3 points)
People reached: 600
